title: Intelligence source says Netflix's Dark mirrors the true UFO program

tellings.quote: show called Dark, and according to Jay Anderson at Project Unity, a senior member of the American intelligence community told him that the show almost perfectly encapsulates the true UFO program.

plain: A senior member of the American intelligence community is said to have told a man named Jay Anderson, of a UFO research group called Project Unity, that the Netflix drama series Dark almost perfectly captures the real UFO program. Michels repeats this from what Anderson said he was told. If true, it would mean the hidden program looks a lot like the show's story.
